Field Descriptions

ENTROPY_CHURN_ENABLE

Entropy Churning Mode Enable. When asserted high, incoming entropy data is XORed with existing FIFO data located at (write_ptr + DEPTH/2) % DEPTH before being written. This creates a circular feedback churning pattern where new entropy is combined with entropy from halfway around the FIFO buffer (16 entries earlier for DEPTH=32). Churning operation: write_data = incoming_data XOR mem[(wptr + 16) % 32]. Purpose: Enhance entropy quality through continuous churning of fresh randomness with accumulated randomness. Useful for additional conditioning and resistance to entropy source degradation. Default=0 (disabled, direct write without churning).

ENABLE

FIFO write enable control. When enabled (1=default), entropy data flows into FIFO and write pointer updates normally. When disabled (set to 0), write operations are blocked: no entropy pushed, write pointer frozen, data collection paused. IMPORTANT: Read operations remain functional when disabled - software can still drain the FIFO by reading FIFO_RDATA. This allows capturing a snapshot of entropy and reading it out without new data being added. Use case: Stop entropy collection, drain FIFO for analysis, re-enable collection. Default=1 (enabled).
